connection.note: geometry feedback off is a comparator only: its mechanics stays at the reference geometry while its kinematics and conduction follow lam; orders are reported, not gated, because yield states switch

reuse.scope: one matched reference evolution after the other controls; warm root/stress guesses and one reference eigensystem with per-step clock factors versus cold roots and the retained support re-assembled at the step's effective geometry and eigendecomposed every accepted step; creep terms rebuilt at every stage in both; not a generator or world forecast

case.scope: closed, laterally uniform, incompressible plane-strain material strip of unit strike under affine pure shear, driven by a constant external force against disjoint generalised drag and the layered column resistance at the current geometry, overburden and temperature, with material-coordinate conduction of the column's own creep/plastic dissipation and radiogenic heat; not asthenospheric inflow, extraction, lateral localisation, rupture, breakup, melting, Eulerian/I05 transport, spherical/world assembly, native integration or calibration

provenance.physics: reviewed cases/i01_thermomechanical_motion_v1.json and, through it, cases/i01_column_heat_v1.json, cases/i01_weakening_v1.json and cases/i01_motion_coupling_v1.json: layered material, densities, rheology, weakening law, gravity, inherited history, thermal layer properties, boundary temperatures and heat fractions (1, 1), all unchanged
provenance.drive: the reviewed motion-case drive 2e13 N/m of strike, generalised drag 5e22 Pa s and belt width 1e5 m, used unchanged as the reference width w0 at lam = 1; authored controls, not calibrated Earth values
provenance.duration: 1e14 s: the column force always opposes motion, so |v| <= |F|/D = 4e-10 m/s and |lam - 1| <= |F| t/(D w0) = 0.4 for any column state and either sign of the drive; the window [0.6, 1.4] is therefore guaranteed before running. Chosen from that bound, not from an expected speed
provenance.windows: stretch [0.6, 1.4] is exactly the drag-only reachable range at 1e14 s and no wider; temperatures [273, 1613] K are the reviewed surface and strip-base boundary temperatures
provenance.boundaries: the reviewed fixed temperatures act at the material surface (273 K) and at the material base of the closed strip (1613 K), which moves to depth h0/lam; the region below is not modelled and contributes only this declared boundary conduction
provenance.oracles: clock oracle: the column-heat case's two-layer eigenmode fixture under prescribed linear stretch histories ending at 1.375 and 0.625; homogeneous oracle: the column-heat case's insulated uniform wet-quartzite layer, whose supplied mean pressure is treated as the material point's reference overburden and scales as 1/lam
provenance.authored: step counts, quadrature orders, prescribed oracle histories, departure amplitudes, refusal fixtures and the two new stretch refinement gates are authored control inputs frozen before any run

representation.geometry: closed laterally uniform incompressible plane-strain strip of unit strike; affine pure shear about the surface: w = w0 lam, z = z0/lam, h = h0/lam; no inflow, extraction, births or mixing
representation.finite_strain: log stretch ln(lam) with lam_dot = v/w0 = a lam; raw engineering plastic history is constitutive memory, never geometry
representation.control: constant external driving force balanced by disjoint generalised drag and the layered column resistance at the current geometry, overburden and temperature at every stage
representation.thermal: material-coordinate conduction C0 dT/dt = -lam^2 (K0 T - b0) + radiogenic + mechanical heat; constant per-material properties, perfect layer contact, fixed-temperature surface and strip base; fixed enthalpy reference
representation.heating: column creep plus plastic dissipation deposited once per material control volume; external drag dissipation is not column heat; no latent or adiabatic heat
representation.time_integration: one reference eigensystem; ETD2 along the thermal clock dtau = 2 dt/(lam_n^-2 + lam_a^-2); the same stage weights integrate history, stretch and every account; accepted endpoint re-solved before commit

drive.source: reviewed motion-case drive, drag and reference width through the thermomechanical case, unchanged
